XenotypeDef.label: sacrifice
XenotypeDef.description:
Sacrifices are ageless super-humans powered by dark archites in the bloodstream. They are a distorted version of the mechamata xenotype and are effectively sub-xenotypes. They are partially immortal, incredibly resilient, and can freely alter their genetic code. But their main distinguishing feature is their connection to the void, which can be both a curse and a blessing.
<color=#f5ffa2>Gameplay Effect (Abilities):</color> Xenogenes editing requires sacrifices.
